\[
J_{k+1} = \delta_N(J_k) \wedge f
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(J_k\): The marker after k steps
- \(N\): The 3 x 3 cross or square

J_0 is the image moved down by h, clamped below the image f. Each step dilates J with the 3 x 3 element N and takes the minimum with f. Geodesic erosion swaps dilation with erosion and minimum with maximum, starting from the image moved up by h. After enough steps, the result is the reconstruction.
